standard_prerequisites.name: The Koszul complex on a regular sequence is exact except in degree zero where its cohomology is the quotient by the sequence
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the exactness of the Koszul complex K_bullet on the polynomial ring.

standard_prerequisites.name: Sheafification on Proj is exact and kills modules supported in positive degree such as the quotient by the coordinates
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the exact complex of graded modules into an exact complex of vector bundles ending at O_X.

core_obligations: View P^n_A as Proj of the polynomial ring S = A[X_0, ..., X_n] and form the Koszul complex K_bullet on X_0, ..., X_n; since the coordinates form a regular sequence, More on Algebra, Lemma regular-koszul-regular gives exactness except in degree 0 with cohomology S/(X_0, ..., X_n) (proof lines 4338-4350).

Grade the complex by placing the generators of K_i in degree +i, obtaining an exact complex 0 to S(-n-1) to ... to S to S/(X_0, ..., X_n) to 0 of graded modules with binomial multiplicities (proof lines 4350-4356).

Apply the exact sheafification functor of Constructions, Lemma proj-sheaves; the quotient term lies in its kernel, so the result is the exact complex 0 to O_X(-n-1) to ... to O_X(-n-1+i)^{binom n i} to ... to O_X to 0 of vector bundles (proof lines 4356-4366).
Twist by the invertible sheaves O_X(n + a + 1) for the given a in Z to obtain the exact complexes of the lemma (proof lines 4366-4369).
proof_roadmap: Build the Koszul complex and get its exactness from the regular sequence (proof lines 4338-4350).
Grade it into an exact complex of graded free modules (proof lines 4350-4356).
Sheafify, dropping the quotient term, and twist to arbitrary shift (proof lines 4356-4369).
